name: dokkit
description: Wire the repository you are in into Dokkit, and ask your Dokkit server what broke from inside Claude Code.

server.title: Dokkit server address
server.description: Your server's address, such as https://dokkit.example.com. Leave it empty until you have a server.

token.title: Dokkit token
token.description: A token made in your server's Settings (dku_...). It decides which tools the agent is offered.
